notes: All 13 candidates audited: nine discovery and four diamond records. Only difficulty, metrics and ranking audit notes are supplied; no route/fee fields were changed.

Bands are explicitly identified agent judgments within each venue’s topical niche, not calibrated acceptance probabilities, cross-disciplinary prestige scores, or recommendations of scientific validity. Single-digit defined journal rates support very_high; demanding explicit contribution criteria or disclosed rates support high. No moderate label was inferred from missing evidence.

Numeric values are official publisher/editor reports. Null year/population/value denotes a missing definition, missing statistic, or unresolved conflicting official figures. An access date is never substituted for a metric year. Some metrics are retained as undated publisher displays and cannot support same-period comparisons.

Wiley acceptance: accepted papers divided by all final decisions during 2025, including desk rejections; not submissions received during 2025. T&F acceptance: all article types receiving final decisions in the previous full calendar year, including desk rejections; on this 2026 check this is 2025. T&F exact six-month speed windows are unstated. Definitions: https://authors.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/find-a-journal/journal-metrics.html ; https://authorservices.taylorandfrancis.com/publishing-your-research/choosing-a-journal/journal-metrics/

Wiley Journal Citation Indicator population details were not verified and remain null. JIF/CiteScore publication windows are the standard metric-year windows; citation indicators reflect journals and not individual manuscripts. Country-reach rankings and unqualified best quartiles were not converted into difficulty scores.

ScienceDirect journal Insights and direct T&F pages returned 403. T&F figures/definitions were recovered from official indexed page text and are weaker access evidence than a direct page read; Elsevier citation values from official shop/listings lack explicit metric years. No third-party acceptance or competitiveness figures were adopted.

SoSyM’s February 2026 editor summary supplies a 2025 rate without denominator; the current homepage and editorial conflict on JIF, five-year JIF and downloads. Those three canonical values remain null, with both reported figures and sources recorded. The acceptance rate is not computed from 466 received submissions.

JEMC and IJIEM timing statements lack measurement periods and populations; they are labeled policy-stated descriptions. JSS, SJM, JEMC and IJIEM retain unknown difficulty; this does not mean easy acceptance. Fees, scientific fit, AI-use policy compliance and human scientific judgment require separate checks.
